category.title: Learning & Study
category.description: Browser-local tools for planning, practicing, checking, and reflecting on learning.

tools.title: Study Session Blueprint
tools.description: Turn a topic, available time, and preferred learning modes into a timed session sequence with concrete outputs.
tools.limitations: It is a planning aid, not a guarantee of retention; adjust for your energy, accessibility needs, and course requirements.

tools.title: Exam Topic Prioritizer
tools.description: Rank exam topics using your confidence, importance, and estimated minutes so the next study block targets the highest-value gaps.
tools.limitations: Scores reflect only the topics you enter and are not a prediction of exam questions or grades.

fields.label: Topics, one per line as Topic | confidence 1-5 | importance 1-5

tools.title: Practice Problem Coverage Matrix
tools.description: Compare manually tagged practice problems with a list of concepts, show coverage counts, untested concepts, and overrepresented concepts.
tools.limitations: Tags must be supplied by the user; it does not grade answers or predict mastery.

fields.label: Problems, one per line as Problem label | concept1, concept2

testValues.problems:
Solve equation | Algebra
Read graph | Graphs, Algebra
Estimate limit | Limits

tools.title: Active Recall Cue Builder
tools.description: Create varied, answerable recall cues from a compact list of topics, definitions, and examples without generating answers for you.
tools.limitations: Cues are structural prompts, not verified questions; review them for course-specific accuracy.

fields.label: Study items, one per line as Term | definition or fact
fields.placeholder: Osmosis | movement of water across a membrane

testValues.items: Osmosis | movement of water across a membrane

tools.title: Problem-Set Pacing Planner
tools.description: Break a problem set into timed rounds with review buffers based on problem count, difficulty mix, and a target completion time.
tools.limitations: Actual solving time varies by subject and problem; the plan does not assess correctness.

tools.title: Study Break Pattern Designer
tools.description: Design a repeatable study-and-break rhythm from a total window and maximum uninterrupted focus time.
tools.limitations: This is not medical or ergonomic advice; take additional breaks whenever needed.

tools.title: Course Grade Target Planner
tools.description: Calculate the average score needed on remaining assessments to reach a target course percentage from completed weighted work.
tools.limitations: This is arithmetic only; grading policies, rounding, dropped scores, and extra credit may change the real result.

tools.title: Vocabulary Encounter Planner
tools.description: Schedule varied encounters with a set of vocabulary items across a short study window, including context, retrieval, and usage checks.
tools.limitations: It does not provide translations or judge language proficiency; supply accurate meanings yourself.

tools.title: Lab Report Checklist Scorer
tools.description: Score the completeness of a lab-report draft against weighted sections and identify the sections with the largest point opportunities.
tools.limitations: A checklist score is not a scientific validity review and cannot replace instructor requirements or safety review.

fields.label: Sections, one per line as Section | earned points | possible points

tools.title: Research Question Refiner
tools.description: Test a proposed research question for focus, scope signals, and observable evidence terms, then suggest a tighter question pattern.
tools.limitations: It evaluates wording heuristically and does not establish disciplinary significance or ethics approval needs.

fields.label: Draft research question
fields.placeholder: How does sleep duration relate to memory recall in first-year students?

testValues.question: How does sleep duration relate to memory recall in first-year students?

tools.title: Source Synthesis Matrix
tools.description: Compare sources across claims, evidence types, and agreement so a literature review can reveal convergence and gaps.
tools.limitations: The comparison is based on your labels and excerpts; it does not verify sources or citations.

fields.label: Sources, one per line as Source | claim | evidence type | stance
fields.placeholder: Smith 2024 | practice improves recall | experiment | supports

testValues.sources: Smith 2024 | practice improves recall | experiment | supports

tools.title: Practice Exam Blueprint
tools.description: Build a balanced practice-exam outline from total questions, topic weights, and cognitive-level targets.
tools.limitations: The blueprint is a distribution aid and does not predict an instructor’s exam or validate item quality.

fields.label: Topics, one per line as Topic | weight percent

tools.title: Study Error-Log Analyzer
tools.description: Classify a problem-solving error log by error type and recommend a targeted review action for the most frequent pattern.
tools.limitations: Recommendations are generic study prompts; the tool cannot inspect the original problems or determine why an error occurred.

fields.label: Errors, one per line as item | type | note

tools.title: Learning Objective Measurability Checker
tools.description: Inspect learning objectives for observable action verbs, an object, and a measurable condition, then flag vague wording.
tools.limitations: Verb heuristics are language-based and may not fit every discipline or legitimate exploratory objective.

fields.label: Objectives, one per line
fields.placeholder: Compare two sampling methods using three criteria

testValues.objectives: Compare two sampling methods using three criteria

tools.title: Skill Prerequisite Roadmap
tools.description: Turn a skill ladder into milestones with prerequisite checks and a practical demonstration for each stage.
tools.limitations: The order is inferred from your numbering and prerequisite labels, not from external standards.

fields.label: Skills, one per line as level | skill | prerequisite

tools.title: Study Distraction Protocol Builder
tools.description: Create a before/during/after protocol from your top distractions and the study context, with a measurable return-to-task rule.
tools.limitations: It cannot change device settings or address clinical attention concerns; use it as a personal experiment.

fields.label: Distractions, one per line
fields.placeholder:
phone notifications
unclear next step
room noise

testValues.distractions:
phone notifications
unclear next step
room noise

tools.title: Peer Review Rubric Builder
tools.description: Create a weighted peer-review rubric from criteria and weights, with scoring anchors that make feedback more consistent.
tools.limitations: It produces a draft rubric; instructors should adapt criteria, accessibility, and grading consequences.

fields.label: Criteria, one per line as Criterion | weight percent

tools.title: Office Hours Question Organizer
tools.description: Transform rough questions into an office-hours agenda grouped by concept, attempted work, and the specific help requested.
tools.limitations: It organizes your notes but does not answer questions or replace course communication policies.

fields.label: Questions, one per line as Topic | what I tried | question
fields.placeholder: Derivatives | chain rule example | Where does the inner derivative enter?

testValues.questions: Derivatives | chain rule example | Where does the inner derivative enter?

tools.title: Tutorial Sequence Planner
tools.description: Arrange a lesson sequence with an activate, model, practice, check, and transfer phase within a fixed duration.
tools.limitations: It is a generic instructional structure and does not assess learner needs or subject-specific pedagogy.

tools.title: Learning Project Rubric Self-Assessor
tools.description: Score project criteria against weighted evidence and produce a prioritized revision list before submission.
tools.limitations: Self-scores are subjective and should be checked against the official rubric and instructor feedback.

fields.label: Criteria, one per line as Criterion | weight | score 0-4 | evidence note

tools.title: Concept Comparison Table
tools.description: Build a compact comparison table from concepts and distinguishing dimensions to expose similarities, differences, and blank cells.
tools.limitations: It only formats the comparisons you provide and does not determine which dimensions matter in your field.

fields.label: Dimensions, one per line
fields.placeholder:
purpose
number of divisions
genetic similarity

fields.label: Entries, one per line as Concept | Dimension | note

testValues.dimensions:
purpose
number of divisions
genetic similarity

tools.title: Learning Objective Verb Classifier
tools.description: Heuristically group supplied learning-objective sentences by recognizable action verbs (recall, explain, apply, analyze, evaluate, create).
tools.limitations: Verb dictionaries are incomplete and context matters; this is an editable teaching aid, not an assessment.

testValues.objectives:
Define a term
Explain a process
Apply a formula
Analyze a graph
Evaluate an argument
Design an experiment
Understand the topic

tools.title: Knowledge Confidence Calibrator
tools.description: Compare confidence ratings with quiz results for topics and calculate a simple calibration gap to reveal over- or under-confidence.
tools.limitations: It is meaningful only for the topics and scores you enter; a small sample is noisy and not a measure of ability.

fields.label: Records, one per line as Topic | confidence 0-100 | result 0-100

tools.title: Study Question Ladder
tools.description: Turn a broad study topic into progressively more specific questions that move from recall to explanation, application, and evaluation.
tools.limitations: The ladder is a prompt sequence, not a complete lesson or a guarantee that each question matches your curriculum.

fields.label: Known fact or definition
fields.placeholder: A warmer atmosphere can hold more water vapor
